_comment: Dojo lesson surface — the navigable mirror of skills/dojo/SKILL.md. The SKILL.md remains the pedagogical source of truth; edit there first, then keep this file in sync. lib/dojo_shell.py loads this file (with an inline fallback), and tests/test_dojo_lessons.py asserts the ids/names match the SKILL's three lessons so the two surfaces cannot drift silently.
